name: scd-feature-specs
description: Purely documentary per-feature spec workflow: the downstream suite of scd-project-docs. Consumes the kickoff socle (prd/stack/adr/CLAUDE.md) and produces, for one or several features, the documents development will build on — spec → plan → tasks — then attests they are ready for optimal implementation. Seven user-invoked phases (kickoff, specify, clarify, plan, tasks, analyze, premortem) plus a status dashboard, with EARS acceptance criteria, one-question-at-a-time interview, plan-mode planning and Kiro-style backreferences. Tasks are grouped into review lots (Rn): vertical slices sized so that a human can actually review each one once implemented — a perfectly traced contract shipped as one block yields a review nobody really does. Blocking criteria are qualitative (single subject, vertical slice, understandable alone); the numeric thresholds (~400 diff lines, ~7 concepts, ~60 min) are advisory split signals, since they are transposed from code-inspection studies and the budget is a documentary estimate, not a measurement. The analyze gate runs 14 read-only checks (traceability, EARS conformance, verifiable verbs over adjectives, technology-agnostic spec, EXCLUDED scope, socle coherence, slice verticality/cohesion/sizing) and returns a Critical/Major/Minor verdict. The optional premortem phase then hardens a conformant contract adversarially: three subagents — a facilitator projects the shipped feature failing and traces the cause back into the contract (broad product + documentary lenses), a validator triages the risks (rejecting speculation, already-covered, scope creep and style), and an applier writes only the human-approved remediations into spec/plan/tasks (new EARS criterion, FR, EXCLUDED item, task, plan note or ADR candidate), after which analyze is re-run since the contract changed. Everything touching code is OUT of scope — neither writing it nor reviewing it afterwards; no test is ever executed here: the split makes the downstream review possible, it does not conduct it. Every command resolves its target feature from disk, so state survives /clear with no state file to drift, and documenting several features in parallel is safe. Ships an ADR-immutability PreToolUse hook, a format PostToolUse hook, two read-only auditor subagents with disjoint mandates (contract and slicing) plus a three-agent premortem crew (facilitator, validator, applier), OpenSpec brownfield deltas, a propose-only spec-drift maintenance loop and a Gherkin complement. Human decides the what; Claude drafts against templates, interviews to fill gaps, adversarially audits both the contract and its slicing, and — only with explicit human approval — hardens the contract against projected failure.
